item.title: Re: Seeking Greenlight (paintbrush of fate
item.content:encoded:
This idea is underdeveloped, and a bit cliche too: Another essentially unstoppable Scp that'll kill anyone that fulfills certain criteria.

Also, Scps without a central narrative rarely get greenlights. Maybe the narrative can be about the Foundation discovering the paintbrush and the bloodbath that surely preceded it?

item.title: Seeking Greenlight (paintbrush of fate
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Other (I dont know what to classify as)

Page Layout (Optional): Basic i.e no images, just a simple table and text

Elevator Pitch: A paintbrush which when it come within 1km contact of paint will paint the victims death, then force said death to happen.

Central Narrative: none

Hook/Attention-Grabber: its basically unstoppable, it can detect even the most microscopic fleck of paint on ones person

Additional Notes: might add pictures and narratives later
